home.hero.eyebrow: Open source · in-process · rsyslog today, more dialects coming
home.hero.title: Know exactly where every log goes
home.hero.description: {name} parses your log-pipeline configuration, builds a normalized model, and simulates a syslog message through it — emitting a trace of every condition, lookup, variable, and action with full source locations. No regex hacks, no shelling out to rsyslog.
home.yourConfig.title: Your config
page.simulator.title: Simulator
page.simulator.description: Send a synthetic syslog message through your parsed configuration and see exactly what happens.
page.replay.title: Replay
page.replay.description: Drop a batch of real syslog through your parsed configuration and see where the traffic actually lands.
page.diff.title: Diff
page.diff.description: Replay the same batch through your live config and an overlaid variant — see what changes before you merge.
page.migrate.title: Migrate
page.migrate.description: Convert your live config to another dialect. The output is a working starting point; the wizard surfaces every translation caveat so you know what to refine by hand.
page.detection.title: Detection-Impact
page.detection.description: Run Sigma detection rules against a replay corpus. Optionally diff against an overlay config to see if a routing change cuts your SOC visibility.
page.config.title: Configuration
page.config.description: Browse the parsed configuration tree, view file contents, and inspect parser diagnostics.
page.tests.title: Tests
page.tests.description: Expectation files dropped into conf/tests/*.json are executed against the parsed configuration.
page.blog.title: Blog
page.blog.description: Notes, design write-ups, and project updates.
page.projects.title: Projects
page.projects.description: Local-mode workbenches. Clone the live server config, upload a folder of conf files, or stash configs in your browser as named projects to switch between.
projects.deletePrompt: Delete project "{name}"? This only removes the browser-stored copy.
projects.cloneOk: Cloned live config as "{name}" and switched to local mode.
projects.noConfigFiles: No recognized config files found in the selection. Looking for .conf, .json, .yaml, .yml, or .toml.
projects.cloneLive.title: Clone live config
projects.cloneLive.description: Snapshot the server's current config into a local-mode project. From there you can edit it in your browser without touching the live host.
projects.uploadFolder.title: Upload folder
projects.uploadFolder.description: Pick a directory from your machine; every .conf, .json, .yaml, and .toml under it becomes part of the project.
projects.uploadFiles.title: Upload files
projects.uploadFiles.description: Pick one or more files. Useful when your config sits next to non-config files you don't want to ship.
projects.saved.title: Saved projects
projects.saved.emptyDescription: Clone the live config or upload a folder above to get started.
projects.uploadZip.title: Upload ZIP
projects.uploadZip.description: Drop a .zip archive containing your config tree. Every .conf, .json, .yaml, and .toml inside is extracted in-browser.
projects.dropzone.hint: or drop a folder, files, or a .zip anywhere on this page
projects.review.title: Review import
projects.review.name: Project name
projects.review.sizeWarning: Heads up: {size} is close to the browser's localStorage limit (~5 MB). Mount the directory into the server container for larger bundles.
